title: Stability verdict
description: Whether the framework may claim a maturity state. The aggregate score may never override a zero-tolerance failure: a scoreboard that can average away a violated invariant is not a control. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':'). Digest is sha256 over those bytes as 'sha256:<hex>'. Backward compatibility: additive optional fields are minor; removing a field, narrowing an enum or adding a required field is MAJOR and takes a new $id.

evidence_against_advancing.description: Required even when advancing. A maturity claim with no stated counter-evidence is a self-assessment, and the reviewer has nothing to check.

stable.description: const false in v1. FRAMEWORK_STABLE requires three consecutive epochs against a frozen scope on two pilot projects; zero epochs have started. A schema that could express stability today would let it be claimed today.
